name: Stantec public project facts
use: Seven short factual project summaries and official links. Approximate coordinates assigned independently; no company GIS files or images redistributed.
licence: Original factual summaries; linked source content remains Stantec copyright

name: BC Freshwater Atlas — Stream Network
use: 1,019 stream features intersecting the study envelope. Used for route intersection counts. Complete paginated query, not a sample of first 1,000 records.

name: BC Digital Road Atlas — Master Partially-Attributed Roads
use: 2,300 road features intersecting the study envelope. Used for straight-line proximity; not proof of road access.

name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles — elevation
use: Elevation decoded from Terrarium tiles, resampled to approximately 100m. Derived slope and route elevation profiles; source tile resolution and vintage vary.
licence: Canada terrain contains information licensed under Open Government Licence – Canada; SRTM/GMTED2010/3DEP courtesy USGS; full notices in docs/ATTRIBUTION.md

name: Derived terrain slope
use: Degrees from elevation gradients with local metre spacing; orange overlay >15°, dark >30°. Preliminary screening, not geohazard classification.

name: AAFC 2020 Land Use
use: A 2020 land-use clip using the provider simplified rendering function. 160 × 140 nearest-neighbour cells. Not a current vegetation map. Display and route samples only; not used in route ranking.

name: Hypothetical routes and inspections
use: 3 route alternatives and 20 training inspections. No real site inspection or Stantec design is represented. Measurements use the real reference data.
licence: Original demonstration content by Jacob Analem

name: Basemap services
use: OpenStreetMap, CARTO light tiles, Esri World Imagery. Tiles are streamed, not bundled. Internet required; no bulk downloading. Use subject to each provider policy.
licence: © OpenStreetMap contributors; © CARTO; © Esri and imagery providers
